description: This file contains a unit test class for the LeaveEntitlementAPI endpoint in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the API's create functionality and validation rules. It sets up mock services and fixtures, and verifies correct behavior and validation handling for creating leave entitlement records.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementAPIEndpointTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class extending EndpointTestCase, focusing on testing the LeaveEntitlementAPI endpoint's creation and validation logic within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixtures from a YAML file into the test database.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of leave entitlement via the API, asserting correct data normalization and no meta data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rules for the create API are correctly defined and validate the input data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOneExpectInvalidParamException
methods.description: Checks that invalid parameters fail validation and trigger the appropriate exception during get-one validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOneExpectInvalidParamExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides various datasets with invalid parameters to test validation failures.
